effective.basis: TCG release of the first printing carrying the errata'd text (LCGX-EN219, Legendary Collection 2: The Duel Academy Years Mega Pack)

changes.historical_text: Activate only when a face-up "Vennominon the King of Poisonous Snakes" you control is destroyed. Special Summon 1 "Vennominaga the Deity of Poisonous Snakes" from your hand or Deck.
changes.modern_text: When a face-up "Vennominon the King of Poisonous Snakes" you control is destroyed, except by battle: Special Summon 1 "Vennominaga the Deity of Poisonous Snakes" from your hand or Deck.
changes.summary: Functional erratum: v1 (LCGX-EN219) inserted 'except by battle' into the trigger condition, so the modern card only activates when a face-up 'Vennominon the King of Poisonous Snakes' you control is destroyed by a non-battle cause. The v0 text (TAEV-EN069) says only 'Activate only when a face-up "Vennominon the King of Poisonous Snakes" you control is destroyed', with no battle exclusion, so battle destruction was a legal trigger in the era. Ignis's anime card 511002525 shows the engine delta directly: its script is the modern script plus EFFECT_FLAG_DAMAGE_STEP+EFFECT_FLAG_DELAY on the EVENT_DESTROYED trigger.

gap.reason: Project Ignis ships no historical implementation of this card; reproducing the era behaviour needs a custom script and a reserved passcode
gap.behavioural_impact: In a period format Vennominon dying in battle no longer fetches 'Vennominaga the Deity of Poisonous Snakes' from the hand or Deck, which removes the era card's most common line of play.

review.notes: Edison- and GOAT-era text is v0 (TAEV-EN069, 2007-08-15); the erratum is 2011-10-04, after both snapshots. The modern cdb text matches lineage v1 exactly (ratio 1.0), so there is no cdb/lineage conflict here - the difference is a genuine printed erratum. The packet's one upstream code, 511002525, is NOT usable as the historical implementation: it is a different card, named 'Rise of the Sacred Deity (Anime)', so substituting it would rename the card and change any name-keyed handling. It is however an exact engineering reference for the fix - its only script difference from the modern card is the added EFFECT_FLAG_DAMAGE_STEP+EFFECT_FLAG_DELAY on the destruction trigger, which is precisely what an era script needs to let battle destruction in the Damage Step start the chain. I have not claimed the DELAY half is era-attested; only the battle-destruction legality follows from the text lineage.
